meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入已完成的小说，自动拆解成可续写的项目结构。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有半成品或已完成的小说，想导入系统继续按流程创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels and restructure them into a project for continued writing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a partially or fully written novel and want to bring it into the writing workflow.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把用户已有的小说（半成品或完本）拆解成一套标准项目结构，包括设定、大纲、正文、追踪等文件夹，并生成拆解分析文档，让用户可以直接接着写。长篇走长篇拆解，短篇走短篇拆解。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /story-import 或说出「导入小说」「反向解析」等指令，要求导入已有小说时触发。

say.note: Claude 开始按流程拆解并建工程

say.text: 帮我反向解析这部小说，做成能续写的项目。
say.note: Claude 创建项目结构并生成大纲等

say.text: 把我的书导进来，按短篇走。
say.note: Claude 按短篇管道拆解并迁移

howto.what_en: Claude parses an existing story (partial or complete) into a standard project structure (settings, outline, text, tracking) plus analysis docs, enabling continued writing. Routes long vs. short stories automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user inputs /story-import or says phrases like 'import novel' or 'reverse-parse' to import an existing story.

say_en.note: Claude starts parsing and building the project.

say_en.text: Please reverse-parse this novel into a continuable project.
say_en.note: Claude creates project structure and outline.

say_en.text: Import my book and treat it as a short story.
